faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Agromet Observer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Agromet Observer post is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Agromet Observer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10+2 examination from a science stream and possess basic computer knowledge. Additionally, MS-CIT certification and specific typing speeds in Marathi and English are required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Agromet Observer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Agromet Observer post is 38 years as of 27th August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Agromet Observer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Agromet Observer position will receive a fixed pay of Rs. 36,890/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Agromet Observer vacancy?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it with the required details, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Agromet Observer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Agromet Observer posts will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Agromet Observer in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Agromet Observer position is contractual.
